services.name: Taproom Trail
services.desc: Sip your way through the Capital City Region with the #FredTapTrail, the first of its kind in New Brunswick! The #FredTapTrail is a passport-style map allowing craft beer and craft cider fans to choose their taproom adventure. Every time you grab a pint or flight at one of the taprooms listed on the map, you will receive a stamp, enabling you to collect exclusive #FredTapTrail swag. Crafty connoisseurs who collect a stamp from all 11 participating partners will be entered into the grand prize draw for a getaway weekend to the Fredericton Craft Beer Festival in March, including tickets for two, two nights’ accommodation and Downtown Fredericton Dollars.
